title: HyperLend core pool (HyperEVM) — stock AaveOracle with no staleness check; two dead feeds (USDHL 60.1d, PT-sUSDe-25SEP2025 127.3d) on soft-delisted reserves
closed_reasons: AaveOracle.getAssetPrice reads only source.latestAnswer() and requires price>0; no updatedAt/heartbeat/bounds check anywhere (flaw is live)
USDHL dead feed (60.1d) is ACCURATE: oracle 0.99779574 vs real 0.99956 -> understates 0.18%; cannot over-borrow
USDHL is soft-delisted: supplyCap=1 AND borrowCap=1, both already exceeded (7696 supplied / 3778 borrowed) -> supply() and borrow() revert
USDHL LTV=0 and is in no e-mode collateralBitmap -> cannot be collateral
PT-sUSDe-25SEP2025 dead feed (127.3d) is ACCURATE/conservative: oracle 0.99904247 vs true ~1.00 -> understates ~0.1%
PT-sUSDe-25SEP2025 supplyCap=1 already exceeded (1.4511 supplied) -> supply() reverts even in e-mode cat 3 (75% LTV)
every reserve with a live LTV has a fresh feed (<=0.05d); 18/18 scanned
the two dead feeds are unmanipulable: PythOracleAdapter needs a signed Pyth update; ChainlinkConsumer enforces monotonic timestamps (OldData) -> stale only, not manipulable
isolated pairs (~$110k total) use OracleChainlink which DOES enforce maxOracleDelay (reverts 'invalid oracle price'); the one stale oracle sits on a ~$1 pair

PT-sUSDe-25SEP2025 0xb7379d395F3c83952ad794896205f7E33E358735 feed 0x8514D528275025AD9bE6019e6e189DFeF1Db6c5e = PendlePriceCapAdapter (matured, discount 0) reading SingleFeedProvider 0x6926d2C4f5aecD82192A9faf7B8e09A1d103bf23 (Chainlink Data Streams USDe/USD); updatedAt 1781949599 = 127.3d stale; price 0.99904247

CORRECTION to pass-7: e-mode cat 3 'PT-sUSDe / stablecoins' (LTV 7500) has collateralBitmap=0x800 -> PT-sUSDe is e-mode collateral at 75% LTV (reserve LTV is 5bps); bitmaps hidden by legacy getEModeCategoryData(), read from Pool storage slot 55
CORRECTION to pass-7: both dead-feed reserves are soft-delisted (supplyCap=1 & borrowCap=1, already exceeded) - a second gate beyond LTV
fork-proven trigger: with USDHL LTV 70% + open caps, 1,000,000 USDHL of dead-feed collateral yields availableBorrowsBase $698,457.02 (borrow power 0.698457/USDHL) and borrow(USDC,100000e6) succeeds
fork-proven trigger: with PT supplyCap opened, 100,000 PT in e-mode 3 yields availableBorrowsBase $74,928.19 (0.749282/PT) and borrow(USDT0,50000e6) succeeds

isolated pairs: registry 0xf55AF86c9EC3a7d5fa6367c00a120E6B262f718d, 4 HyperlendPair contracts; 0x06Fd(USDT0/WHLP ~$71k) 0xb8fE(USDT0/xHYPE ~$1) 0x78DD(USDC/xHYPE ~$22k) 0x9465(WHYPE/kmHYPE ~$15k); maxOracleDelay 7d (x3) / 70d (x1)
caveats: read-only: no tx signed/sent; PoC is fork-only (GitHub Actions, keyless public HyperEVM RPC)
point-in-time 2026-10-25; caps/LTV/feeds can change - re-read before acting
getEModeCategoryData() returns only the legacy struct; v3.4 bitmaps must be read from raw Pool storage (slot 55)
trigger tests use vm.store state overrides (open caps / raise LTV); they measure the mechanism and ceiling, not a live drain
no path is attacker-triggerable today - all triggers need a governance/config change or a stablecoin depeg
one_liner: HyperLend's $467.7M core pool uses a stock AaveOracle with no staleness check and two genuinely dead feeds (60d/127d), but E-U is $0 because both feeds are accurate and both dead-feed reserves are soft-delisted (supplyCap=1 & borrowCap=1 exceeded; USDHL LTV=0); re-arm trigger = a dead feed gaining a real LTV + an open cap + a >30% depeg (USDHL) or the e-mode-3 PT supplyCap opening + a USDe depeg below ~$0.748.
